title: Feature: hook to transform asset/data URLs at SSR (for version-skew protection on Vercel et al.)
author: ap-justin
body_preview: ## Summary  React Router framework mode lacks a hook to transform asset and single-fetch URLs at SSR time. This blocks platforms (Vercel, Netlify, etc.) from implementing version-skew protection the way Next.js, SvelteKit, Astro, Qwik, and Nuxt do — by suffixing a deployment id (e.g. `?dpl=<id>`) onto every framework-managed client request so stale HTML still resolves its content-hashed chunks aft...
